Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.v20260728

package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.v20260728
MCP 2026-07-28 binding for juneau-rest-server-mcp.

Contains everything that knows about the 2026-07-28 wire format: the JSON-RPC method table, the mapping between the revision-neutral model in org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp and the wire beans in org.apache.juneau.bean.mcp.v20260728, this revision's JSON-RPC error-code table, and the two entry points a consumer binds against (McpRestServlet for the servlet-subclass path and McpEndpoint for the mixin path).

    McpMrtrCapabilityContext

    McpOptions
